detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

GLOW-Plus (BPC-157/GHK-Cu/TB-500/Thymosin Alpha-1 Blend)

Chemical Information:
  • BPC-157:
    • Molecular Formula: C62H98N16O22
    • Molecular Weight: 1419.54 g/mol
    • Sequence: Gly-Glu-Pro-Pro-Pro-Gly-Lys-Pro-Ala-Asp-Asp-Ala-Gly-Leu-Val
  • GHK-Cu:
    • Molecular Formula: C14H24N6O4Cu
    • Molecular Weight: 403.96 g/mol
    • *)“GHK-Cu may appear as ~340 Da (peptide only) or ~404 Da (copper complex) depending on MS conditions. The blue color confirms copper is present in the complex.”
    • Sequence: Gly-His-Lys-Cu
  • TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4):
    • Molecular Formula: C212H350N56O78S
    • Molecular Weight: 4963.44 g/mol
    • Sequence: Ac-Ser-Asp-Lys-Pro-Asp-Met-Ala-Glu-Ile-Glu-Lys-Phe-Asp-Lys-Ser-Lys-Leu-Lys-Lys-Thr-Glu-Thr-Gln-Glu-Lys-Asn-Pro-Leu-Pro-Ser-Lys-Glu-Thr-Ile-Glu-Gln-Glu-Lys-Gln-Ala-Gly-Glu-Ser
  • Thymosin Alpha-1:
    • Molecular Formula: C129H215N33O55
    • Molecular Weight: 3108.28 g/mol
    • Sequence:
    • Sequence: Ac-Ser-Asp-Ala-Ala-Val-Asp-Thr-Ser-Ser-Glu-Ile-Thr-Thr-Lys-Asp-Leu-Lys-Glu-Lys-Lys-Glu-Val-Val-Glu-Glu-Ala-Glu-Asn-OH
Product Description:

The “GLOW-Plus” Blend is a research formulation consisting of four structurally defined synthetic peptide components: BPC-157, GHK-Cu, TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4), and Thymosin Alpha-1. Each component is produced through controlled synthesis and combined in a standardized formulation for use in laboratory research environments. This blend is utilized in controlled experimental settings for analytical evaluation of peptide behavior, stability, and interaction within defined systems. All applications are limited to in vitro research models. The product is supplied in lyophilized powder form to support stability and integrity during storage and handling.

Research Applications:

The GLOW-Plus Blend is utilized in controlled laboratory research settings for applications such as:

  • Analytical evaluation of peptide structure and composition within multi-component systems
  • Examination of stability and degradation profiles of combined peptide formulations
  • Investigation of peptide behavior in biochemical and in vitro assay environments
  • Characterization of interactions between peptide components under controlled experimental conditions
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at -20°C.
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2-8°C and use promptly.
  • Protect from direct sunlight and avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
  • Maintain aseptic techniques during laboratory handling.
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

The GLOW-Plus (BPC-157/GHK-Cu/TB-500/Thymosin Alpha-1 Blend) is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
